expo.locationAddress: Stilson Lot, Beckley Park Way, Jackson, WY
notes: Mobile IV will be onsite as an official recovery partner. You can prep for the race with an IV at the expo or meet them at the finish line.
This is a cup-free event — there will be no disposable cups on the course. Bring a handheld bottle or hydration vest.
Our expo is bag-free. Don't forget to Bring Your Own Bag (BYOB)!
We cannot accommodate runners before 12:00 PM.

parkingOptions.name: Ranch Lot (Stilson Ranch)
parkingOptions.details: Opens at 4:00 AM. Shuttles run to the start line and back from the finish line. Last shuttle departs at 5:45 AM.

parkingOptions.name: 250 N Cache St, Jackson
parkingOptions.details: Opens at 4:00 AM. Single pickup shuttle at 4:30 AM. Walking or drop-off is strongly recommended as parking is very limited.

shuttleDetails.label: Return service to and from the finish line

raceMorning.dropOffNote: There is a dedicated drop-off zone at the start line. Vehicles must drop off runners there, then proceed forward and take a left on Beckley Parkway to exit. Once runners begin lining up, drop-off diverts to the north lot. All runners must be dropped off before 5:30 AM.

courseInfo.strollerPolicy: Jogging strollers are permitted in the Half Marathon and 5K. Please start at the back of your corral.
courseInfo.dogPolicy: Dogs are not permitted on the course.
courseInfo.aidStations: Aid stations are located approximately every 2 miles on the Half Marathon course. Each station is stocked with water and electrolyte drink. This is a cup-free event — bring your own vessel.
courseInfo.recoveryFood: Post-race recovery food will be available at the finish line.

spectators.notes: Because the course runs on the highway and a large portion on Spring Gulch Road, it is not a very spectator-friendly course. Spectators are welcome at the finish line by shuttle access only.
warnings: There is NO parking at the finish line or along Spring Gulch Road.
Do not drive or park on Spring Gulch Rd — this creates a dangerous environment for runners and causes serious traffic problems.
spectators.shuttleAccess: Spectators can access the finish line via shuttle from the Ranch Lot. Return service runs from 7:00 AM through post-race.

postRace.finishLineInfo: The finish line is located near the Stilson Ranch area. Post-race food and celebrations will be available.

items.question: If I can't pick up my bib on Friday at the pre-race expo, can I pick it up race morning?
items.answer: Yes — race morning bib pick up opens at 4:45 AM at the start line area. We strongly encourage all Half Marathon runners to pick up at the Friday expo if possible to avoid any delays on race morning.

items.question: This is a cup-free event — what does that mean?
items.answer: There will be no disposable cups at aid stations. All runners must bring a handheld bottle, hydration vest, or collapsible cup. Water and electrolyte drink will still be available at all aid stations.

items.question: Where should I park on race morning?
items.answer: The Ranch Lot (Stilson Ranch) is the primary parking option and opens at 4:00 AM. Shuttles run to the start from 4:30–5:45 AM. Parking is very limited at 250 N Cache St in Jackson — walking or drop-off is strongly recommended there.

items.question: Can spectators watch the race?
items.answer: The course is not very spectator-friendly due to highway and Spring Gulch Rd sections. Spectators are welcome at the finish line by shuttle access only. There is absolutely no parking at the finish line — please use the shuttle from the Ranch Lot.

items.question: Are strollers and dogs allowed?
items.answer: Jogging strollers are permitted in both the Half Marathon and 5K — please start at the back of your corral. Dogs are not permitted on the course.

items.question: What is the volunteer opportunity?
items.answer: We're always looking for volunteers for expo and race day shifts. Perks include up to $100 off a future Vacation Races event. Credits are transferable and can be combined. Sign up via the link in your registration confirmation email.
